Settings.QueryText: SELECT Return.Ref, Return.Date, Return.CashRegister, Return.Company, Return.Hotel, Return.Sum, Return.VATRate, Return.VATSum, Return.GuestGroup, Return.Payer, Return.Folio, Return.ExternalCode, Return.ParentDoc, Return.Author, Return.AccountingDate, Return.PaymentMethod, Return.DeletionMark, Return.Number, Return.AccountingCustomer, Return.Posted FROM Document.Return AS Return WHERE (Return.Hotel IN HIERARCHY (&qHotel) OR &qHotel = VALUE(Catalog.Hotels.EmptyRef)) AND CASE WHEN &qDateListMode = 0 THEN Return.Date BETWEEN &qDateFrom AND &qDateTo ELSE Return.AccountingDate BETWEEN &qDateFrom AND &qDateTo END
